correctness.rationale: The universal Hilbert quadrilateral identity on all rook rectangles implies U+V>=4 and D^2>=2. The exact Hilbert centroid identity and cross-edge bound imply D^2(2MN+M-N)>=4N(M-1)+MN(1-1/h). Orthogonal centered regular simplices attain the maximum lower bound for every integer m,n>=2,h>=1. Equality analysis establishes all optimal configurations at and above the threshold; an orthogonal translation proves nonrigidity below it. CHECKER.py independently evaluates 154006 exact rational labelled-pair constraints across 224 finite cases, confirming but not replacing the proof.

value.rationale: The exact three-parameter formula and condition (h-1)/(2h)>1/m+1/n identify when adjoining a universal clique genuinely changes the Euclidean distortion of a two-dimensional Hamming metric. The phase comes from competing four-point and two-population variance obstructions. Binding optima are uniquely determined in the asymmetric case, but display a full interval of inequivalent simplex scales in the balanced case; the limit sqrt(5/2) supplies a sharp family-level extremum. This is a structural classification of a natural family, not a single unmotivated computation.
